coordinate_rule: Parse saved array_row x array_col identifiers; x_um = array_row * sqrt(3)/2 * 100, y_um = array_col * 100/2, exactly as SecAct calWeights().
grouping_scope: Per-sample Seurat expression graph clusters; not cell-type annotations or deconvolution.
contact_policy: Cell-contact restriction disabled: conventional Visium spots are multicellular capture locations; all computable LR categories use the documented 200 um spot neighborhood. contact.range is inactive.
lr_policy: Full human SpatialCellChat database filtered only for mandatory measured gene coverage by SpatialESS filter_cellchat_lr; no overexpression selection or result-based selection.
duplicate_gene_policy: Sum rows with exactly identical gene symbols before normalization; no alias remapping.
study_policy: All metadata samples enter the queue independently, in metadata order. Keep failures and excluded inputs; never pool spatial graphs across samples.
comparison_scope: SpatialESS-only computational feasibility, not reference-equivalence validation, cell-type-specific biological discovery or independent SecAct validation.
